approved_tools.en: No named institutionally licensed AI tool verified. Four assessment categories are not tool endorsements.
approved_tools.zh: 未核实任何具名校方许可工具；四种考核类别不构成工具背书。

research_publication.en: A postgraduate research AI policy was approved, but its operative text and thesis rules are unavailable.
research_publication.zh: 已公布研究型研究生AI政策获批，但未取得正式全文和论文适用规则。

academic_integrity.en: General regulations provide appeals and meeting rights; AI-specific misconduct decision process not verified.
academic_integrity.zh: 总规章规定申诉及会议陪同权；AI专门违纪程序未核实。

teaching_guidance.en: DCAD recommends reviewing marking criteria and discussing AI in assessment briefs.
teaching_guidance.zh: DCAD建议修订评分准则、在作业要求中讨论AI使用。

security_procurement.en: No official procurement, vendor security or AI tool approval workflow retrieved.
security_procurement.zh: 未取得官方AI工具采购、供应商安全审核或审批流程。

coursework.en: Senate-updated GenAI policy (June 2026); each assessment specifies one of four categories: No GenAI Allowed, Selective, Allowed, or Embedded (using GenAI is required).
coursework.zh: 参议院更新的生成式AI政策（2026年6月）；每项考核分别指定四种类别之一：禁止使用（No GenAI Allowed）、选择性允许（Selective）、允许使用（Allowed）或内置必用（Embedded，必须使用GenAI）。

exams.en: Assessment-specific GenAI category rules; check whether an examination is designated GenAI-secure / Not Permitted.
exams.zh: 按具体考核适用的生成式AI分类规则；须核实考试是否属于GenAI安全考核或禁止使用类别。

disclosure.en: Direct operative university-wide disclosure clause was not acquired in full; verify required acknowledgement forms in your module or Common Awards assessment instructions.
disclosure.zh: 本次未取回完整的全校统一披露正文条款；请按所在模块或Common Awards考核说明核实须提交的声明格式。

privacy_data.en: Teaching-staff GenAI guidance requiring open and transparent use, ethical practice, and compliance with GDPR; university-wide retention schedules, student data upload limits, and international data transfers remain unverified.
privacy_data.zh: 教学人员生成式AI指引，要求公开透明、符合伦理并遵守GDPR；全校数据留存计划、学生数据上传限制及跨境传输安排未核实。

approved_tools.en: Assessment-category guidance; access to any AI tool never overrides a Not Permitted or Selective assessment designation.
approved_tools.zh: 考核分类指引；任何AI工具的可访问性均不超越具体考核的“禁止使用”或“选择性允许”设定。

research_publication.en: Senate announcement approving a specific policy for generative AI in postgraduate research degrees (June 2026); operative full text, thesis submission rules, and research publication guidance remain unacquired.
research_publication.zh: 参议院关于批准研究型研究生学位生成式AI专门政策的公告（2026年6月）；正式实施全文、学位论文规则及科研出版指引尚未取得。

academic_integrity.en: General Regulation IV meeting rights and balance-of-probabilities standard; General Regulation VII academic appeals: 21 days from the date of notification of the decision to be appealed, and 14 days from the date of notification of the Faculty Appeal decision for SAAC. The excerpts do not establish calendar versus working days.
academic_integrity.zh: 《通用规章第四章》的会议陪同权与可能性权衡标准；第七章学术申诉：自被申诉决定的通知日期起21天内提出申诉；向SAAC申诉须自学院申诉决定的通知日期起14天内提出。摘录未明确日历日或工作日。

teaching_guidance.en: Programme and module assessment design guidance combining GenAI-secure and GenAI-open assessments.
teaching_guidance.zh: 专业与模块考核设计指引，结合GenAI安全考核与GenAI开放考核进行评估设计。

security_procurement.en: Direct operative university-wide AI procurement clauses were not acquired in this bundle; check CIS/procurement governance.
security_procurement.zh: 本批资料未取回全校AI安全采购直接实施条款；请核对信息服务部（CIS）及学校采购治理规定。

title.en: Check the rules for your work

scope.en: Senate-updated GenAI assessment policy (June 2026) sets assessment-specific categories (Not Permitted, Selective, Allowed); an Allowed designation on one task never applies elsewhere, and stale internal DCAD listing claims are retained as historical only.
scope.zh: 参议院更新的生成式AI考核政策（2026年6月）按具体考核设定类别（禁止使用、选择性允许、完全允许）；单一作业允许使用不代表其他作业可用，过期的DCAD内部目录条目仅作历史保留。

do.en: Check the assessment-specific GenAI category before using AI.
do.zh: 使用前确认该项考核的AI类别。

do.en: Where assessment instructions specify Selective use, stay within the stated use.
do.zh: Selective 类别应严格遵守列明的使用范围。

dont.en: Do not interpret an Allowed designation on one assessment as blanket permission elsewhere.
dont.zh: 不得将某项作业的Allowed扩展到其他作业。
